scientific_integrity: The upper factor follows by evaluating the Bernstein expansion at the mean parameter of a maximizing coefficient; the central index is located by an exact ratio argument; sparse nonnegative vectors show the constant cannot be improved within the elementary-symmetric coefficient cone. The motivating full text and the later Gaffke comparison were inspected, and targeted published-finding corpus/web searches did not reveal the same sharp factor. Search non-retrieval is retained only as a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: The result is a deterministic worst-case comparison between SymPol and the optimized constant-bet KL-inf statistic. It does not quantify typical power, confidence-interval width, or the gap to stronger mergers such as Gaffke's under independence. Sharpness is approached by sparse vectors with diverging coordinates.
title: Exact worst-case gap between SymPol and optimized constant betting
